purpose: Bind an ex-date/effective-date event inventory to immutable raw responses; no independent source authenticity guarantee from hashes
rules: An empty event list is acceptable only for a source query/document explicitly covering the requested identity, event class and date basis; otherwise events remain null.
Process-date inventory is not silently relabeled ex-date inventory.
An issuer ordinary dividend schedule cannot cover exceptional actions.
Preserve both positive and negative receipts, every page and cancellations/corrections.
Convert split ratio only from documentednew_rate/old_rate; never infer it from price movement.
Keep original_known_at null when the publication/receipt clock was not observed; retrieval time is not historical availability.
Deduplicate by provider event ID and revision, rejecting inconsistent duplicates.
Residual unsupported classes remain declared; coverage is scoped to the provider, not a claim about all conceivable events.
A newly detected unresolved event invalidates dependent historical valuations or signals; retain position/entitlement state, do not silently erase it or reset equity.
current_missing: Complete supported exceptional-action ex-date/effective-date receipt for the stated scope
